inputs.text:
# Week 1
## Upper Power
/// Speed work weight on hypertrophy days is auto-derived at 65% of power day weight
power_speed / used: none / 1x1 / progress: custom(increment: 5lb, minReps: 3, maxReps: 5, powerDay: 1, speedDay: 3) {~
  if (dayInWeek == state.powerDay) {
    if (completedReps >= reps && reps[ns] >= state.maxReps) {
      weights += state.increment
      reps = state.minReps
    } else if (completedReps >= reps) {
      reps += 1
    }
  }
~} / update: custom() {~
  if (setIndex == 0 && dayInWeek == state.speedDay) {
    weights = weights[ns] * 0.65
    reps = 3
  }
~}

main: Bent Over Row / 3x3 / 115lb / 180s / ...power_speed
power: Pull Up / 2x6 / 0lb / 120s / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
power: Chin Up / 2x6 / 0lb / 120s / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
